cg.settings.title: ⊹ CHARACTER GRID ⊹
cg.settings.intro: Choose how the character grid looks and what it shows.
cg.settings.enabledDesc: Turn off to get SillyTavern's normal home screen back without disabling the extension.
cg.settings.cardThemeDesc: Choose the gradient and text color shown over portraits.
cg.settings.gradientColorDesc: Choose the color that fades upward over portraits.
cg.settings.columnsDesc: Use the exact selected count on larger screens. Phones use two columns.
cg.settings.pageSizeDesc: Choose how many characters load in each page of the library.
cg.settings.showToolbarDesc: Show a slim bar above the grid for finding and ordering characters. Press / to jump to search.
cg.settings.showLastChatDesc: Show when you last talked to each character under their name.
